initial_scene: The humanoid faces the foreground table, which holds a single crumpled white paper-like wad near its edge. Behind the humanoid is a waste station with landfill, recycling, and compost compartments. The compost front opening is the rightmost hexagonal opening in the camera view.

observed_sequence.action: Robot holds its initial standing pose beside the table; white wad is on the tabletop and both hands are empty.
Anatomical right arm bends inward and reaches forward/down toward the crumpled wad; left hand stays away from the target.

Right hand encloses the white wad on the table and closes around it, compressing the wad before lifting. Native frames 160 and 204 show contact and a closed hold while the wad remains at tabletop level.
Right hand lifts the wad clear of the table and draws it upward toward the chest, retaining the grasp.

Robot steps away from the table, pivots toward the waste station, and walks forward until its back faces the camera. Right elbow remains bent with the paper held in front of the torso; left arm hangs free.
Robot extends its right arm toward the rightmost compost opening, positioning the held paper at the mouth of the bin.

Right arm remains extended at the compost opening with the paper still visibly held beneath/between the fingers, while the robot makes small stance adjustments. Native frames 604, 700, 706, and 710 retain the visible wad.

Right hand opens at the bin opening. The white wad descends beneath the fingers in native frame 714 and is absent by native frame 718, disappearing inside the dark opening rather than traveling in an observable long throwing arc.
Robot holds its now-empty right hand briefly near the opening, withdraws it, and steps backward away from the station. Final frame shows the empty right hand bent forward and the left arm lowered.
